user.title: Welcome: connect your inverter
user.description:
Choose your battery connection: SMA STP SE, SMA Sunny Boy Storage or SMA Sunny Island (both read-only tests) or an existing Huawei Solar integration. Configure the connection and operating mode in the following steps.

Warning: With write access enabled, Opti Akku actively controls battery charging and discharging. Incorrect settings or errors may cause additional electricity costs, unintended operation or damage. Follow the manufacturer’s requirements and disable other writing controllers before enabling write access. Shadow mode remains strictly read-only.

If a Shadow entry is already loaded, setup also offers “Copy Shadow settings for active control”.

sma_connection.description: The connection check reads only. The SMA Sunny Boy Storage and SMA Sunny Island profiles are read-only tests: they always run in shadow mode and never control the battery. Configure total PV generation and the AC power of your PV inverters as sources.

huawei_device.title: Select Huawei Solar device
huawei_device.description: Select the battery inverter of a loaded Huawei Solar entry. Shadow stays permanently read-only. For future control choose a standard entry; its write access also starts disabled.

data_description.huawei_device_id: Battery inverter of a loaded Huawei Solar entry.
data_description.shadow_mode: Reads only and never writes to the device. A shadow entry stays read-only for good; active control later uses a separate standard entry.

huawei_sources.title: Map Huawei Solar measurements
huawei_sources.description: Map fresh Huawei measurements to the battery inverter. Capacity may be Wh or kWh; select the grid-power sign explicitly. Configure additional generators under plant and sources.

data_description.soc: Battery state of charge in percent from Huawei Solar.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Rated battery capacity in Wh or kWh.
data_description.battery_power_w: Charge and discharge power of the battery.
data_description.pv_power_w: AC output power of the inverter.
data_description.grid_power_w: Power at the grid connection point. Set the sign direction in the field below.
data_description.battery_temp: Optional. Enables temperature derating and cut-off while charging.
data_description.pv_generation_w: Optional. DC power of the PV strings, for display only.
data_description.grid_positive: Whether a positive grid power value means import or export. A wrong direction distorts the house consumption.

sources.title: System and measurements
sources.description: Native plant balance is recommended for new SMA installations and requires confirmation that the grid meter covers all selected loads and generators. Select additional inverter AC outputs, never DC strings. Select whole-home consumption in W or kW where needed. Optional PV sources override SMA measurements. External house consumption must be an unsmoothed total. Excluded loads affect the forecast profile independently of EV locking. Legacy preserves the previous calculation for imports and existing entries. The minimum applies only to the forecast. Balance mode uses native AC power; an alternative hybrid AC source is not allowed in this mode. Select only loads already excluded above that do not report unchanged zero power regularly and reliably become unavailable on connection loss. With a positive age limit, this exception applies only to exactly 0 W or 0 kW; positive power still requires a recent report. With age limit 0, HA availability applies to external power sources, heat-pump power in the demand profile and resting cell spread instead.

data.single_inverter: Calculate house consumption from this single inverter
data.event_based_excluded_sources: Excluded loads with zero valid until changed
data.plant_meter_confirmed: The grid meter covers all selected generators and loads
data.source_max_age: External measurement reporting age (seconds, 0 = HA availability)
data.house_consumption_max_age: House consumption reporting age (seconds, empty = as above)

data_description.house_consumption: Unsmoothed house consumption of the whole plant in W or kW. Leave empty to let Opti Akku calculate it from grid, PV and battery power.
data_description.pv_generation: Optional. DC power of the PV strings, for display only. Overrides the value read from SMA.
data_description.pv_power: Optional. AC power of the hybrid inverter including the battery. Overrides the value read from SMA; not allowed in balance mode.
data_description.single_inverter: Calculates the house consumption from this inverter's balance instead of a separate sensor. Only suitable if no other generator is connected at the grid connection point.
data_description.plant_mode: The native plant balance is recommended for new SMA plants. Legacy keeps the previous calculation for imports and existing entries.
data_description.additional_ac_sources: AC output power of further inverters, not DC strings. Included in the house consumption balance.
data_description.excluded_load_sources: Loads such as a wallbox that are removed from the learned load profile. They only affect the load profile.
data_description.event_based_excluded_sources: Only loads already excluded above whose integration does not regularly report an unchanged 0 W and reliably marks outages as unavailable. For them exactly 0 W stays valid without an age limit.
data_description.plant_meter_confirmed: Required for the native plant balance: the grid meter must cover all selected generators and loads.
data_description.forecast_min_load_w: Lower limit of consumption used by the forecast. Applies only to the forecast, not to the measurement.
data_description.strategy_enabled: Calculates operating mode and power automatically. Does not enable writes on its own; when off, the battery stays paused.
data_description.huawei_battery_temp: Optional. Battery temperature from Huawei Solar for temperature derating and cut-off.
data_description.source_max_age: Default: 900 seconds. Applies to external power values, heat-pump power in the demand profile and resting cell spread. 0 trusts HA availability even for unchanged values. Sources and templates must report failures as unavailable; frozen values still marked available cannot be detected. An old high resting cell spread may bring balancing forward. Native battery, temperature, price and forecast checks keep their limits. Changing this restarts the consumption profile.
data_description.house_consumption_max_age: Optional. For a smoothed house consumption source in legacy mode, for example a 60-minute average template: it may stay unchanged and then reports nothing new in HA. Suggestion for a 60-minute average: 3600. Empty uses the general age limit, 0 trusts HA availability. A frozen source still marked available is detected only after this limit. Setting or changing this restarts the consumption profile.

battery.title: Battery and power limits
battery.description: Set charge-level limits and maximum charge/discharge power from your battery specifications or previous controller. These are strategy limits, not verified hardware protection. Capacity and temperature are read automatically.

data_description.minsoc: Lower state of charge the strategy discharges the battery to. Default 10 %.
data_description.maxsoc: Upper state of charge the strategy charges the battery to. Default 95 %.
data_description.akkusteuerung_max_ladestaerke: Highest charge power Opti requests. This is a strategy limit; the limits of inverter and BMS still apply.
data_description.akkusteuerung_max_entladestaerke: Highest discharge power Opti requests. This is a strategy limit; the limits of inverter and BMS still apply.
data_description.opti_pv_ueberschuss_ladung: Lets the strategy charge daytime PV surplus into the battery, including the 70 % limit, the AC surplus limit and the feed-in release.
data_description.akkusteuerung_wr_ac_ueberschuss_grenze: 0 turns this off. Useful when PV power exceeds the inverter's AC power and output is clipped around midday. The battery then charges from surplus above the limit if PV surplus charging is allowed. Suggestion for the detected model: {ac_limit_suggestion}. The value is not applied automatically.
data_description.opti_manuelle_ladegrenze: Temporarily uses the maximum charge power instead of the forecast-based steps. Temperature, upper state-of-charge and balancing limits stay in effect. Turns off again after a restart or reload, except for the reload after enabling an Opti entity.
data_description.charge_curve: Up to five points of charge level and maximum charge power. From a point's charge level upwards its power is the upper limit; when the charge level falls, a point holds until it is 2 percentage points below it. Below that band of the first point the curve does not limit. Example: from 85 % 4000 W, from 93 % 3000 W, from 99 % 250 W, at 100 % 70 W. It applies in every mode, including manual modes and grid charging, and only lowers: temperature, balancing and maximum charge power stay active, and a PV peak does not lift it. Power must not rise with the charge level. 0 W blocks charging from that point. Leave empty for unchanged behaviour.

tariff.title: Electricity tariff
tariff.description: Tibber uses dated prices from your existing HA integration. Confirm your home and euro tariff in the next step. For other providers, select both price entities; today/tomorrow must contain complete intervals with start, end and timezone. For operation without price optimization, choose Entities and leave both price fields empty. Fixed time windows: enter your tariff's daily windows with start, end and price in the next step, e.g. for a cheap night window.

data_description.price_current: Current electricity price. Leave empty if no price optimisation is wanted.
data_description.price_series: Entity with dated prices for today and tomorrow: complete intervals with start, end and time zone.
data_description.price_unit: Unit of both price entities. Contradictory euro and cent values are rejected.
data_description.ladepreis: -1 means no reference charging price is known yet. Existing saved values are retained during upgrades. The strategy writes this value after grid charging; it is informational and has no control effect.
data_description.mindestpreisdifferenz_lade_entladepreis: Display only, no control effect: feeds the sensor Opti Mindestentladepreis (reference charging price plus margin). No strategy branch reads it.
data_description.opti_einspeiseverguetung_ct: Your feed-in tariff. With a poor forecast and grid charging allowed for the reserve, the strategy may charge from the grid while the price is below it. At 0 this only applies to negative prices.
data_description.opti_netzlade_spread_ct: Minimum gap between the charge price and the average of the coming price peaks before the battery is precharged from the grid. Applies in addition to the economics of the battery model. Default 10 ct/kWh.
data_description.opti_peak_min_aufschlag_ct: A time slot only counts as a price peak if it is at least this much above the lowest price in the planning horizon. Default 5 ct/kWh.
data_description.opti_halte_spread_ct: In expensive hours the battery is only held back for even more expensive peaks if their average price is at least this much above the current price. Default 5 ct/kWh.
data_description.hausakku_aus_netz_laden: Sets the charge target to the maximum state of charge instead of the target derived from the PV forecast. Turns itself off again from 99 % state of charge.
data_description.price_provider: Where prices come from: your own price entities, the existing Tibber integration or the fixed time windows of your tariff.

forecast.title: PV forecast
forecast.description: Select all three forecast sensors in kWh or Wh. Solcast and Forecast.Solar need compatible source sensors; provider sign-in is not configured here. Leave all three empty to skip forecasts; predictive reserve planning is then limited. Optimism blends available conservative and normal estimates.

data.opti_prognose_netzladen: Allow reserve planning with grid charging

data_description.forecast_today: PV forecast for today in kWh or Wh. The estimate10 attribute (P10) is used when present.
data_description.forecast_tomorrow: PV forecast for tomorrow in kWh or Wh. The estimate10 attribute (P10) is used when present.
data_description.forecast_remaining: Remaining PV forecast for today in kWh or Wh. The estimate10 attribute (P10) is used when present.
data_description.opti_forecast_optimismus: Blends the cautious P10 forecast with the median: 0 % uses only P10, 100 % only the median. Default 0 %.
data_description.opti_peak_verbrauch_kw: Fallback house load during price peaks while no peak load profile is available. The peak reserve uses it to estimate how much battery the peaks need.
data_description.opti_prognose_netzladen: Allows grid charging for the reserve: with a poor forecast and a price below the feed-in tariff, and to precharge before price peaks. Without it the strategy does not charge from the grid in these cases.

ev.title: EV charging: evcc connection (optional)
ev.description: For evcc loadpoints. Select both mode and charging status. Optionally select Smart Cost active. While charging in now or legacy minpv mode, or in pv/smart mode with Smart Cost active, home battery discharge can be blocked; normal solar charging does not block discharge. The evcc alwaysCharge option in smart mode is not detected separately. Battery charging remains allowed. Without an EV charger, leave sources empty and the block off. To remove this feature, clear all sources and turn the block off.

data_description.ev1_mode: evcc charge point 1: entity with the charge mode. Select only together with the charging state.
data_description.ev1_charging: evcc charge point 1: entity showing whether it is charging.
data_description.ev1_smart_cost: Optional. Shows whether smart cost is active. Discharging can then also be blocked in pv/smart.
data_description.ev1_power: Optional. Charge power of charge point 1, for example to subtract it from the house consumption in the demand profile.
data_description.ev2_mode: evcc charge point 2: entity with the charge mode. Select only together with the charging state.
data_description.ev2_charging: evcc charge point 2: entity showing whether it is charging.
data_description.ev2_smart_cost: Optional. Shows whether smart cost is active. Discharging can then also be blocked in pv/smart.
data_description.ev2_power: Optional. Charge power of charge point 2, for example to subtract it from the house consumption in the demand profile.
data_description.opti_ev_akku_pause: Blocks discharging of the house battery while a car charges in now or minpv, or with smart cost active. Normal PV charging does not block; charging the house battery stays possible.

balancing.title: Balancing (optional)
balancing.description: Optional. Interval 0 disables all balancing planning. When planning is enabled, cell spread may trigger additional demand. Grid charging needs separate permission. New entries do not import counters from previous automations; existing integration counters are preserved. The cell-spread source is optional and can be removed. The reporting-age setting under System and measurements also applies to resting cell spread. With 0, the last available resting value remains valid regardless of age and can trigger balancing; the interval, threshold, cooldown and separate grid-charge permission still apply. The optional lowest-cell-voltage source and the cell voltage reserve (0 = off, otherwise 2.90 to 3.10 V) end discharging early once the lowest cell reaches the reserve under load (use a fast-updating sensor, at most 3 minutes old); the protection is released once the lowest cell is 0.20 V above the reserve, and is kept if the source drops out, because the state of charge becomes unreliable at the bottom. Without a source or with 0 nothing changes.

data.cell_voltage_min: Lowest cell voltage (optional, e.g. BYD BMU)

data_description.cell_spread: Optional. Cell spread of the BYD battery at rest. A large spread can trigger additional balancing need.
data_description.cell_voltage_min: Fast updating sensor of the lowest cell voltage (V or mV), for example from a BYD BMU. Values older than 180 s count as stale. Needed for the cell voltage reserve.
data_description.opti_balancing_intervall_tage: Balancing is due after this many days since the last full charge to 100 %. 0 turns balancing planning off.
data_description.opti_balancing_karenz_tage: Extra days after the interval before balancing may charge from the grid at night at a cheap price below the balancing price limit. Requires grid charging for balancing.
data_description.opti_balancing_max_ct: Highest price for grid charging for balancing after the grace period. 0 turns this path off.
data_description.opti_balancing_done_soc: Balancing counts as complete after 30 minutes above this state of charge; at 100 % reaching 100 % is enough. A change restarts the confirmation.
data_description.opti_balancing_haltezeit_h: After a completed balancing, keeps discharging blocked for this time and allows PV recharging only. Holds only at price levels very cheap, cheap or normal. 0 = off.
data_description.opti_balancing_halten_vor_peak: Gives a running balancing hold window priority over peak discharging, as long as the price is valid and at most 60 ct/kWh. Without PV this can raise grid costs.
data_description.opti_balancing_spreizungs_schwelle: Brings balancing forward when the resting cell spread reaches this value and the minimum gap has passed. 0 = off.
data_description.opti_balancing_bedarf_cooldown_tage: Minimum days since the last full charge before a high cell spread brings balancing forward.
data_description.opti_balancing_netzladen: Allows balancing to charge from the grid at night: below the feed-in tariff, or after the grace period at a cheap price up to the balancing price limit. Off by default.
data_description.opti_zellspannung_reserve_v: Holds the battery like the minimum state of charge when the lowest cell stays at or below this voltage under load for 60 seconds. 0 = off, otherwise 2.90 to 3.10 V; 3.00 V is a good start. Needs the lowest cell voltage source.

finish.title: Review and save

data_description.shadow_reference_mode: Optional. Mode entity of your previous control. The shadow entry compares its decisions with it.
data_description.single_writer_confirmed: Confirm only when no other automation, integration or manufacturer app controls the battery. Without this confirmation write access stays locked.
data_description.akku_opti_automatik: Calculates the strategy. Off means pause, even when a manual mode is selected. This does not replace the write release.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Fine tuning; defaults are suitable for getting started. Source ages are checked in seconds. Short limits may treat unchanged sources as missing. Apply changes using Review and save.

data_description.akkusteuerung_ladestaerke_soll: Fixed charge power for "fast charge". At most the maximum charge power.
data_description.akkusteuerung_min_ladestaerke: SMA only: lower bound of the charge window. If the calculated charge power is below it, charging stays blocked; otherwise the inverter charges with at least this value. 0 = no lower bound.
data_description.akkusteuerung_entladestaerke_soll: Fixed discharge power for "fast discharge". At most the maximum discharge power.
data_description.akkusteuerung_min_entladestaerke: SMA only: lower bound of the discharge window. If the discharge limit is below it, discharging stays blocked; otherwise the inverter discharges with at least this value. 0 = no lower bound.
data_description.akkusteuerung_wr_70proz_ueberschuss_gren: 0 turns this off. If the feed-in without battery charging exceeds this value during the day, the battery charges from the surplus, for example with a 70 % feed-in limit. Releases again 1000 W below. Requires PV surplus charging.
data_description.akkusteuerung_ueberschuss_veto_grenze: If the feed-in without battery charging exceeds this value during the day, the battery charges beyond the target state of charge up to the maximum state of charge. Requires PV surplus charging.
data_description.akkusteuerung_ueberschuss_veto_aus_grenz: Hysteresis: a running release stays active while the feed-in without battery charging reaches at least this value. Must not be above the release limit.
data_description.akkusteuerung_ueberschuss_veto_knappheit: The release only applies if the forecast PV surplus is smaller than the energy needed to fill the battery times this factor. 1 = only with a tight forecast; higher values also allow it with more expected surplus. Without a forecast it always applies.
data_description.forecast_max_age: Maximum age of PV forecasts. Applies to the daily forecasts, the Solcast intervals of the demand profile, clipping and the planner. Default 43200 s (12 h), because the free Solcast plan allows only four updates per day.
data_description.price_max_age: Maximum age of electricity prices. Older prices count as invalid. Default 7200 s.

tibber.title: Connect Tibber
tibber.description: Uses your existing Tibber login in Home Assistant, without another token or helper. Currently supports exactly one Tibber account with one home. Current price and planning use the same dated series. The HA action does not report a currency: explicitly confirm that your Tibber tariff is billed in EUR/kWh. Cancel this step for other currencies.

data_description.tibber_home: Home from the configured Tibber integration. Exactly one account with one home is supported.
data_description.tibber_eur_confirmed: The Tibber service does not provide a currency. Confirm that your tariff is billed in EUR/kWh.

price_windows.title: Fixed time windows
price_windows.description: Enter the tariff's daily windows in local time with price in ct/kWh. Together they must cover the whole day exactly once, without gaps or overlaps; a window may cross midnight (e.g. 05:00 to 00:00). Start and end use 15-minute steps. Opti Akku builds today's and tomorrow's dated prices from them, including days with daylight saving changes. There is no price age check. If the tariff changes, update the windows here.

data_description.price_windows: Daily windows in local time with a price in ct/kWh, in 15-minute steps. Together they must cover the day without gap or overlap.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Problems always appear as Home Assistant notifications. Optionally select an existing push service. Use the device-page test button to check delivery. The integration cannot alert while HA itself is down.

data_description.notification_service: Optional. notify action for additional push messages, for example notify.mobile_app_phone. Problems always also appear as a Home Assistant notification.

huawei_controls.title: Map Huawei controls
huawei_controls.description:
Map existing Huawei Solar controls for the battery inverter. Mode, excess PV and forced status must belong to the same Batteries device. Missing controls may require enabling parameter configuration in Huawei Solar.

The extra AC-generator option depends on your plant and defaults off.

Warning: writes actively control your battery. Schedules and power limits can persist through HA failure. Disabling attempts a pause; it does not restore the previous configuration automatically. Disable other controllers and verify a recovery path before activation. Write access starts disabled. An unconfirmed pause is saved and retried on reconnection only with the same device binding and single-writer confirmation.

data.huawei_grid_surplus: Allow grid charging in self-consumption for additional AC generators

data_description.mode: Entity for the battery working mode. Must belong to the same Batteries device.
data_description.excess_pv: Entity for excess PV energy use. Must belong to the same Batteries device.
data_description.grid_charge: Entity that allows charging from the grid.
data_description.charge_limit: Entity for the maximum charge power.
data_description.discharge_limit: Entity for the maximum discharge power.
data_description.grid_limit: Entity for the maximum grid charge power.
data_description.cutoff_soc: Entity for the state of charge up to which the battery charges from the grid.
data_description.forced_status: Sensor with the status of forced charging or discharging. Must belong to the same Batteries device.
data_description.huawei_grid_surplus: Depends on the plant, off by default. Allows grid charging in self-consumption so that surplus from further AC generators can reach the battery.

shadow_copy.title: From Shadow to active control
shadow_copy.description:
The selected Shadow entry remains unchanged and read-only. Connection, sources, limits and optional features are prefilled for a new standard entry. Review them in the next steps. After notifications, advanced limits and previously configured optional features are also shown for review.

Write permission, temporary overrides, learned profiles and recordings are not copied. Calculate strategy and write access start off. Disable the previous writing controller before the final confirmation. Without confirmation no standard entry is created.

If no further comparison is needed, you can disable the old Shadow entry afterwards to avoid additional polling. It is not automatically disabled or deleted.

data.confirm_copy: Copy settings into a new standard entry

data_description.shadow_entry: Shadow entry whose settings prefill the new standard entry. It stays unchanged.
data_description.confirm_copy: Confirms that the previous writing control is switched off. Without confirmation, no standard entry is created.

demand.title: Demand profile and peak reserve
demand.description: Learning and comparison remain observational. Optionally use the hourly profile in the active strategy for the peak reserve and remaining-day score, with a 20% peak-reserve margin and the configured fallback load or previous remaining-day calculation. This changes battery control. Heating and hot water are included in the household profile; future cycles are not scheduled. Unknown heat context or detected unquantified hot-water demand retains the safe fallback. Separate heat-meter mode is not yet supported for the active peak profile.

data.enabled: Learn demand profile and observe forecast
data.heat_power: Heat pump total electrical power, included in house consumption
data.dhw_due: Hot water expected before PV (optional demand signal)
data.dhw_cycle_kwh: Measured electrical energy per hot water cycle (0 = unknown)
data.context_water_temperature: Actual hot water temperature (context and demand check)
data.context_water_target: Target hot water temperature (context and demand check)
data.house_includes_ev: House consumption includes EV charging (subtract configured EV power)
data.use_for_peak_reserve: Use hourly profile in the active strategy

data_description.enabled: Learns the house consumption by hour and weekday and compares the forecast. Observation only.
data_description.heat_power: Optional. Electrical power of the heat pump; must be included in the house consumption. It is subtracted and learned separately.
data_description.summer_mode: Optional. Separates summer and winter history.
data_description.heating_active: Optional. Reports active heating of the heat pump.
data_description.dhw_active: Optional. Reports active hot water heating and separates its share from space heating.
data_description.dhw_due: Optional. Signal that hot water is expected before PV starts. Needs the heat pump meter, the hot water active state and kWh per cycle.
data_description.water_temperature: Optional. If the actual temperature is below target minus 2 K, hot water counts as expected.
data_description.water_target: Optional. Target temperature for the comparison with the actual temperature.
data_description.pv_today: Solcast sensor for today with a dated detailedForecast and pv_estimate10. Daily kWh alone are not enough.
data_description.pv_tomorrow: Solcast sensor for tomorrow with a dated detailedForecast and pv_estimate10.
data_description.dhw_cycle_kwh: Measured electrical energy of one hot water cycle. 0 means unknown.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Optional. Outdoor temperature to find similar historical hours.
data_description.context_water_temperature: Optional. Stored as context only and does not trigger hot water recharging.
data_description.context_water_target: Optional. Stored as context only and does not trigger hot water recharging.
data_description.history_house: Sensor for the one-time import from the recorder. Must measure the same consumption scope as the current house consumption.
data_description.house_includes_ev: Only turn on if the house consumption includes the wallbox. The EV power is then subtracted; a change resets the learned profile.
data_description.temperature_matching: Prefers historical hours within 3 °C of the current outdoor temperature, for the first four forecast hours.
data_description.use_for_peak_reserve: Uses the hourly profile for peak reserve and remaining-day score. Changes the battery control.

ev_preparation.title: PV preparation for the car
ev_preparation.description: Prepare the home battery from PV surplus when vehicle SOC is low, including while away. An optional recurring or absolute departure time can add a vehicle target, usable capacity, available charge power and efficiency. Until that deadline, the vehicle target replaces the simple demand threshold. The report shows required energy, latest charge start and feasibility assuming continuous power; the integration does not control the charger. No additional grid charging. While the car charges, ordinary home charging/discharging pauses and priority protection charging remains. Vehicle SOC expires after 24h; an unknown charging state blocks preparation. Minimum discharge power is limited to 0 W while preparation is enabled.

data.vehicle_charge_efficiency_percent: Charging efficiency to the vehicle battery

data_description.enabled: Pulls existing PV surplus into the house battery earlier when the vehicle state of charge is low. No additional grid charging.
data_description.vehicle_soc: State of charge of the vehicle in percent. Valid for at most 24 hours.
data_description.charging: Reliable signal that the car is charging. Active or unknown pauses normal house battery charging and discharging.
data_description.away: Optional. Switch for longer absence; blocks only the preparation.
data_description.departure: Optional. input_datetime or timestamp sensor. A time of day alone applies daily.
data_description.vehicle_threshold: Below this vehicle state of charge, charging is needed.
data_description.house_target: Up to this state of charge the house battery takes in surplus PV early, at most up to the maximum state of charge.
data_description.vehicle_target_soc: Vehicle target at departure. Replaces the simple need threshold until departure.
data_description.vehicle_capacity_kwh: Usable vehicle battery capacity for departure planning.
data_description.charge_power_kw: Available AC charge power for departure planning.
data_description.vehicle_charge_efficiency_percent: Share of AC energy that reaches the vehicle battery.

arbitrage.title: Battery arbitrage estimate
arbitrage.description: Enter your battery cost, lifetime and efficiency assumptions. The display calculates the price spread and residual energy value. Efficiencies, cycle costs and margin also size the peak reserve and decide whether the battery is precharged from the grid before a price peak; invalid values block this precharging. The optional discharge hold retains energy only when complete demand, PV and price forecasts prove that later residual load is materially more valuable. It never starts grid charging and leaves protection, charging and unknown decisions unchanged.

data.hold_enabled: Use residual value as an automatic discharge hold
data.degradation_percent: Assumed battery value loss over the stated cycles
data.margin_ct: Additional margin per kWh battery energy

data_description.enabled: Shows price spread and residual value. Efficiencies, cycle costs and margin also apply to peak pre-charging.
data_description.hold_enabled: Holds energy only with a complete demand, PV and price forecast for a more valuable later residual load. Does not charge from the grid.
data_description.battery_price_eur: Battery share of the purchase price, basis for the cycle costs.
data_description.degradation_percent: Loss of battery value over the assumed full cycles.
data_description.cycles: Number of full cycles the loss of value is spread over.
data_description.usable_capacity_kwh: Usable capacity of the house battery.
data_description.charge_efficiency_percent: Share of grid or PV energy that reaches the battery. 90 % if not set.
data_description.discharge_efficiency_percent: Share of battery energy that reaches the house. 90 % if not set.
data_description.margin_ct: Additional margin per kWh before charging and later discharging pay off.

peak_rank.title: Peak rank control (experimental)
peak_rank.description: Experimental. Otherwise the peak ladder discharges in every hour classified as very expensive or expensive. With this option it holds the battery in an expensive hour when, according to the peak rank shadow comparison, the usable energy only covers even more expensive hours before the next PV refill. Instead of discharging, the mode is then 'Akku nur Laden' (PV charging stays allowed) or, when the strategy currently blocks charging, 'Akku Pause'. It only affects the peak L1 and L2 decisions and only on a clear 'hold' result; with uncertain or missing data the strategy decides as before. Manual modes and all protection functions take precedence. The load and price assumptions can be wrong; energy may then remain unused or expensive grid power may be drawn.

data.enabled: Hold discharge in expensive hours for even more expensive ones

data_description.enabled: Experimental. Holds energy in an expensive hour for even more expensive hours if the battery only lasts for those. Changes the battery control.

observation.title: Observe measurement sources
observation.description: Read-only: active house source stays unchanged. Match the grid connection, additional inverters and excluded loads. HA report timestamps are not proof of a new device measurement. Compare our time-weighted 60-minute value with legacy smoothing; interpolation can differ.

data.instant_house: Unsmoothed house load excluding selected loads

data_description.enabled: Read-only comparison of measurement sources and balance. Does not change the active house source.
data_description.meter_confirmed: Confirms that the grid meter covers the whole plant scope being compared.
data_description.legacy_floor_w: Lower limit the legacy system applied to its average, so the comparison calculates the same way.
data_description.instant_house: Optional. Instantaneous house consumption after subtracting the excluded loads.
data_description.watch_sources: Up to eight further sources whose report times are recorded.
data_description.additional_ac_sources: AC power of further inverters for the balance.
data_description.excluded_load_sources: Loads such as a wallbox subtracted for the comparison after load deduction.
data_description.gross_house: Optional. Instantaneous total house consumption before load deduction.

init.title: Configure Opti Akku
init.description: Edit a section, then open Review and save. Changes remain a draft until saved.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: The new connection is checked read-only. Changes clear the previous writer confirmation. Shadow mode cannot be changed. Apply using Review and save.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the inverter in your local network. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the device.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port of the inverter, usually 502 for SMA.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit ID of the inverter. SMA inverters usually answer on 3.
data_description.profile: Inverter model. Sunny Boy Storage and Sunny Island are only released as a read-only test.

sources.title: System and measurements
sources.description: Native plant balance is recommended for new SMA installations and requires confirmation that the grid meter covers all selected loads and generators. Select additional inverter AC outputs, never DC strings. Select whole-home consumption in W or kW where needed. Optional PV sources override SMA measurements. External house consumption must be an unsmoothed total. Excluded loads affect the forecast profile independently of EV locking. Legacy preserves the previous calculation for imports and existing entries. The minimum applies only to the forecast. Balance mode uses native AC power; an alternative hybrid AC source is not allowed in this mode. Select only loads already excluded above that do not report unchanged zero power regularly and reliably become unavailable on connection loss. With a positive age limit, this exception applies only to exactly 0 W or 0 kW; positive power still requires a recent report. With age limit 0, HA availability applies to external power sources, heat-pump power in the demand profile and resting cell spread instead. Changes remain a draft until you complete Review and save in the menu.

data.single_inverter: Calculate house consumption from this single inverter
data.event_based_excluded_sources: Excluded loads with zero valid until changed
data.plant_meter_confirmed: The grid meter covers all selected generators and loads
data.source_max_age: External measurement reporting age (seconds, 0 = HA availability)
data.house_consumption_max_age: House consumption reporting age (seconds, empty = as above)

data_description.house_consumption: Unsmoothed house consumption of the whole plant in W or kW. Leave empty to let Opti Akku calculate it from grid, PV and battery power.
data_description.pv_generation: Optional. DC power of the PV strings, for display only. Overrides the value read from SMA.
data_description.pv_power: Optional. AC power of the hybrid inverter including the battery. Overrides the value read from SMA; not allowed in balance mode.
data_description.single_inverter: Calculates the house consumption from this inverter's balance instead of a separate sensor. Only suitable if no other generator is connected at the grid connection point.
data_description.plant_mode: The native plant balance is recommended for new SMA plants. Legacy keeps the previous calculation for imports and existing entries.
data_description.additional_ac_sources: AC output power of further inverters, not DC strings. Included in the house consumption balance.
data_description.excluded_load_sources: Loads such as a wallbox that are removed from the learned load profile. They only affect the load profile.
data_description.event_based_excluded_sources: Only loads already excluded above whose integration does not regularly report an unchanged 0 W and reliably marks outages as unavailable. For them exactly 0 W stays valid without an age limit.
data_description.plant_meter_confirmed: Required for the native plant balance: the grid meter must cover all selected generators and loads.
data_description.forecast_min_load_w: Lower limit of consumption used by the forecast. Applies only to the forecast, not to the measurement.
data_description.strategy_enabled: Calculates operating mode and power automatically. Does not enable writes on its own; when off, the battery stays paused.
data_description.huawei_battery_temp: Optional. Battery temperature from Huawei Solar for temperature derating and cut-off.
data_description.source_max_age: Default: 900 seconds. Applies to external power values, heat-pump power in the demand profile and resting cell spread. 0 trusts HA availability even for unchanged values. Sources and templates must report failures as unavailable; frozen values still marked available cannot be detected. An old high resting cell spread may bring balancing forward. Native battery, temperature, price and forecast checks keep their limits. Changing this restarts the consumption profile.
data_description.house_consumption_max_age: Optional. For a smoothed house consumption source in legacy mode, for example a 60-minute average template: it may stay unchanged and then reports nothing new in HA. Suggestion for a 60-minute average: 3600. Empty uses the general age limit, 0 trusts HA availability. A frozen source still marked available is detected only after this limit. Setting or changing this restarts the consumption profile.

battery.title: Battery and power limits
battery.description: Set charge-level limits and maximum charge/discharge power from your battery specifications or previous controller. These are strategy limits, not verified hardware protection. Capacity and temperature are read automatically. The forecast-independent limit uses maximum charge power in automatic modes too. Temperature, upper SoC and balancing limits remain active. It turns off again after restart or reload. Enable it after setup without changing connections or sources in the same save; those changes reload the integration.

data_description.minsoc: Lower state of charge the strategy discharges the battery to. Default 10 %.
data_description.maxsoc: Upper state of charge the strategy charges the battery to. Default 95 %.
data_description.akkusteuerung_max_ladestaerke: Highest charge power Opti requests. This is a strategy limit; the limits of inverter and BMS still apply.
data_description.akkusteuerung_max_entladestaerke: Highest discharge power Opti requests. This is a strategy limit; the limits of inverter and BMS still apply.
data_description.opti_pv_ueberschuss_ladung: Lets the strategy charge daytime PV surplus into the battery, including the 70 % limit, the AC surplus limit and the feed-in release.
data_description.akkusteuerung_wr_ac_ueberschuss_grenze: 0 turns this off. Useful when PV power exceeds the inverter's AC power and output is clipped around midday. The battery then charges from surplus above the limit if PV surplus charging is allowed. Suggestion for the detected model: {ac_limit_suggestion}. The value is not applied automatically.
data_description.opti_manuelle_ladegrenze: Temporarily uses the maximum charge power instead of the forecast-based steps. Temperature, upper state-of-charge and balancing limits stay in effect. Turns off again after a restart or reload, except for the reload after enabling an Opti entity.
data_description.charge_curve: Up to five points of charge level and maximum charge power. From a point's charge level upwards its power is the upper limit; when the charge level falls, a point holds until it is 2 percentage points below it. Below that band of the first point the curve does not limit. Example: from 85 % 4000 W, from 93 % 3000 W, from 99 % 250 W, at 100 % 70 W. It applies in every mode, including manual modes and grid charging, and only lowers: temperature, balancing and maximum charge power stay active, and a PV peak does not lift it. Power must not rise with the charge level. 0 W blocks charging from that point. Leave empty for unchanged behaviour.

tariff.title: Electricity tariff
tariff.description: Tibber uses dated prices from your existing HA integration. Confirm your home and euro tariff in the next step. For other providers, select both price entities; today/tomorrow must contain complete intervals with start, end and timezone. For operation without price optimization, choose Entities and leave both price fields empty. Fixed time windows: enter your tariff's daily windows with start, end and price in the next step, e.g. for a cheap night window.

data_description.price_current: Current electricity price. Leave empty if no price optimisation is wanted.
data_description.price_series: Entity with dated prices for today and tomorrow: complete intervals with start, end and time zone.
data_description.price_unit: Unit of both price entities. Contradictory euro and cent values are rejected.
data_description.ladepreis: -1 means no reference charging price is known yet. Existing saved values are retained during upgrades. The strategy writes this value after grid charging; it is informational and has no control effect.
data_description.mindestpreisdifferenz_lade_entladepreis: Display only, no control effect: feeds the sensor Opti Mindestentladepreis (reference charging price plus margin). No strategy branch reads it.
data_description.opti_einspeiseverguetung_ct: Your feed-in tariff. With a poor forecast and grid charging allowed for the reserve, the strategy may charge from the grid while the price is below it. At 0 this only applies to negative prices.
data_description.opti_netzlade_spread_ct: Minimum gap between the charge price and the average of the coming price peaks before the battery is precharged from the grid. Applies in addition to the economics of the battery model. Default 10 ct/kWh.
data_description.opti_peak_min_aufschlag_ct: A time slot only counts as a price peak if it is at least this much above the lowest price in the planning horizon. Default 5 ct/kWh.
data_description.opti_halte_spread_ct: In expensive hours the battery is only held back for even more expensive peaks if their average price is at least this much above the current price. Default 5 ct/kWh.
data_description.hausakku_aus_netz_laden: Sets the charge target to the maximum state of charge instead of the target derived from the PV forecast. Turns itself off again from 99 % state of charge.
data_description.price_provider: Where prices come from: your own price entities, the existing Tibber integration or the fixed time windows of your tariff.

forecast.title: PV forecast
forecast.description: Select all three forecast sensors in kWh or Wh. Solcast and Forecast.Solar need compatible source sensors; provider sign-in is not configured here. Leave all three empty to skip forecasts; predictive reserve planning is then limited. Optimism blends available conservative and normal estimates.

data.opti_prognose_netzladen: Allow reserve planning with grid charging

data_description.forecast_today: PV forecast for today in kWh or Wh. The estimate10 attribute (P10) is used when present.
data_description.forecast_tomorrow: PV forecast for tomorrow in kWh or Wh. The estimate10 attribute (P10) is used when present.
data_description.forecast_remaining: Remaining PV forecast for today in kWh or Wh. The estimate10 attribute (P10) is used when present.
data_description.opti_forecast_optimismus: Blends the cautious P10 forecast with the median: 0 % uses only P10, 100 % only the median. Default 0 %.
data_description.opti_peak_verbrauch_kw: Fallback house load during price peaks while no peak load profile is available. The peak reserve uses it to estimate how much battery the peaks need.
data_description.opti_prognose_netzladen: Allows grid charging for the reserve: with a poor forecast and a price below the feed-in tariff, and to precharge before price peaks. Without it the strategy does not charge from the grid in these cases.

ev.title: EV charging: evcc connection (optional)
ev.description: For evcc loadpoints. Select both mode and charging status. Optionally select Smart Cost active. While charging in now or legacy minpv mode, or in pv/smart mode with Smart Cost active, home battery discharge can be blocked; normal solar charging does not block discharge. The evcc alwaysCharge option in smart mode is not detected separately. Battery charging remains allowed. Without an EV charger, leave sources empty and the block off. To remove this feature, clear all sources and turn the block off.

data_description.ev1_mode: evcc charge point 1: entity with the charge mode. Select only together with the charging state.
data_description.ev1_charging: evcc charge point 1: entity showing whether it is charging.
data_description.ev1_smart_cost: Optional. Shows whether smart cost is active. Discharging can then also be blocked in pv/smart.
data_description.ev1_power: Optional. Charge power of charge point 1, for example to subtract it from the house consumption in the demand profile.
data_description.ev2_mode: evcc charge point 2: entity with the charge mode. Select only together with the charging state.
data_description.ev2_charging: evcc charge point 2: entity showing whether it is charging.
data_description.ev2_smart_cost: Optional. Shows whether smart cost is active. Discharging can then also be blocked in pv/smart.
data_description.ev2_power: Optional. Charge power of charge point 2, for example to subtract it from the house consumption in the demand profile.
data_description.opti_ev_akku_pause: Blocks discharging of the house battery while a car charges in now or minpv, or with smart cost active. Normal PV charging does not block; charging the house battery stays possible.

balancing.title: Balancing (optional)
balancing.description: Optional. Interval 0 disables all balancing planning. When planning is enabled, cell spread may trigger additional demand. Grid charging needs separate permission. New entries do not import counters from previous automations; existing integration counters are preserved. The cell-spread source is optional and can be removed. The reporting-age setting under System and measurements also applies to resting cell spread. With 0, the last available resting value remains valid regardless of age and can trigger balancing; the interval, threshold, cooldown and separate grid-charge permission still apply. The optional lowest-cell-voltage source and the cell voltage reserve (0 = off, otherwise 2.90 to 3.10 V) end discharging early once the lowest cell reaches the reserve under load (use a fast-updating sensor, at most 3 minutes old); the protection is released once the lowest cell is 0.20 V above the reserve, and is kept if the source drops out, because the state of charge becomes unreliable at the bottom. Without a source or with 0 nothing changes.

data.cell_voltage_min: Lowest cell voltage (optional, e.g. BYD BMU)

data_description.cell_spread: Optional. Cell spread of the BYD battery at rest. A large spread can trigger additional balancing need.
data_description.cell_voltage_min: Fast updating sensor of the lowest cell voltage (V or mV), for example from a BYD BMU. Values older than 180 s count as stale. Needed for the cell voltage reserve.
data_description.opti_balancing_intervall_tage: Balancing is due after this many days since the last full charge to 100 %. 0 turns balancing planning off.
data_description.opti_balancing_karenz_tage: Extra days after the interval before balancing may charge from the grid at night at a cheap price below the balancing price limit. Requires grid charging for balancing.
data_description.opti_balancing_max_ct: Highest price for grid charging for balancing after the grace period. 0 turns this path off.
data_description.opti_balancing_done_soc: Balancing counts as complete after 30 minutes above this state of charge; at 100 % reaching 100 % is enough. A change restarts the confirmation.
data_description.opti_balancing_haltezeit_h: After a completed balancing, keeps discharging blocked for this time and allows PV recharging only. Holds only at price levels very cheap, cheap or normal. 0 = off.
data_description.opti_balancing_halten_vor_peak: Gives a running balancing hold window priority over peak discharging, as long as the price is valid and at most 60 ct/kWh. Without PV this can raise grid costs.
data_description.opti_balancing_spreizungs_schwelle: Brings balancing forward when the resting cell spread reaches this value and the minimum gap has passed. 0 = off.
data_description.opti_balancing_bedarf_cooldown_tage: Minimum days since the last full charge before a high cell spread brings balancing forward.
data_description.opti_balancing_netzladen: Allows balancing to charge from the grid at night: below the feed-in tariff, or after the grace period at a cheap price up to the balancing price limit. Off by default.
data_description.opti_zellspannung_reserve_v: Holds the battery like the minimum state of charge when the lowest cell stays at or below this voltage under load for 60 seconds. 0 = off, otherwise 2.90 to 3.10 V; 3.00 V is a good start. Needs the lowest cell voltage source.

finish.title: Review and save

data_description.shadow_reference_mode: Optional. Mode entity of your previous control. The shadow entry compares its decisions with it.
data_description.single_writer_confirmed: Confirm only when no other automation, integration or manufacturer app controls the battery. Without this confirmation write access stays locked.
data_description.akku_opti_automatik: Calculates the strategy. Off means pause, even when a manual mode is selected. This does not replace the write release.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Fine tuning; defaults are suitable for getting started. Source ages are checked in seconds. Short limits may treat unchanged sources as missing. Apply changes using Review and save.

data_description.akkusteuerung_ladestaerke_soll: Fixed charge power for "fast charge". At most the maximum charge power.
data_description.akkusteuerung_min_ladestaerke: SMA only: lower bound of the charge window. If the calculated charge power is below it, charging stays blocked; otherwise the inverter charges with at least this value. 0 = no lower bound.
data_description.akkusteuerung_entladestaerke_soll: Fixed discharge power for "fast discharge". At most the maximum discharge power.
data_description.akkusteuerung_min_entladestaerke: SMA only: lower bound of the discharge window. If the discharge limit is below it, discharging stays blocked; otherwise the inverter discharges with at least this value. 0 = no lower bound.
data_description.akkusteuerung_wr_70proz_ueberschuss_gren: 0 turns this off. If the feed-in without battery charging exceeds this value during the day, the battery charges from the surplus, for example with a 70 % feed-in limit. Releases again 1000 W below. Requires PV surplus charging.
data_description.akkusteuerung_ueberschuss_veto_grenze: If the feed-in without battery charging exceeds this value during the day, the battery charges beyond the target state of charge up to the maximum state of charge. Requires PV surplus charging.
data_description.akkusteuerung_ueberschuss_veto_aus_grenz: Hysteresis: a running release stays active while the feed-in without battery charging reaches at least this value. Must not be above the release limit.
data_description.akkusteuerung_ueberschuss_veto_knappheit: The release only applies if the forecast PV surplus is smaller than the energy needed to fill the battery times this factor. 1 = only with a tight forecast; higher values also allow it with more expected surplus. Without a forecast it always applies.
data_description.forecast_max_age: Maximum age of PV forecasts. Applies to the daily forecasts, the Solcast intervals of the demand profile, clipping and the planner. Default 43200 s (12 h), because the free Solcast plan allows only four updates per day.
data_description.price_max_age: Maximum age of electricity prices. Older prices count as invalid. Default 7200 s.

features.title: Optional features
features.description: Configure only the optional features you need. Changes take effect only after Review and save.

tibber.title: Connect Tibber
tibber.description: Uses your existing Tibber login in Home Assistant, without another token or helper. Currently supports exactly one Tibber account with one home. Current price and planning use the same dated series. The HA action does not report a currency: explicitly confirm that your Tibber tariff is billed in EUR/kWh. Cancel this step for other currencies.

data_description.tibber_eur_confirmed: The Tibber service does not provide a currency. Confirm that your tariff is billed in EUR/kWh.

price_windows.title: Fixed time windows
price_windows.description: Enter the tariff's daily windows in local time with price in ct/kWh. Together they must cover the whole day exactly once, without gaps or overlaps; a window may cross midnight (e.g. 05:00 to 00:00). Start and end use 15-minute steps. Opti Akku builds today's and tomorrow's dated prices from them, including days with daylight saving changes. There is no price age check. If the tariff changes, update the windows here.

data_description.price_windows: Daily windows in local time with a price in ct/kWh, in 15-minute steps. Together they must cover the day without gap or overlap.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Problems always appear as Home Assistant notifications. Optionally select an existing push service. Use the device-page test button to check delivery. The integration cannot alert while HA itself is down.

data_description.notification_service: Optional. notify action for additional push messages, for example notify.mobile_app_phone. Problems always also appear as a Home Assistant notification.

huawei_controls.title: Map Huawei controls
huawei_controls.description:
Map existing Huawei Solar controls for the battery inverter. Mode, excess PV and forced status must belong to the same Batteries device. Missing controls may require enabling parameter configuration in Huawei Solar.

The extra AC-generator option depends on your plant and defaults off.

Warning: writes actively control your battery. Schedules and power limits can persist through HA failure. Disabling attempts a pause; it does not restore the previous configuration automatically. Disable other controllers and verify a recovery path before activation. Write access starts disabled. An unconfirmed pause is saved and retried on reconnection only with the same device binding and single-writer confirmation.

demand.title: Demand profile and peak reserve
demand.description: Learning and comparison remain observational. Optionally use the hourly profile in the active strategy for the peak reserve and remaining-day score, with a 20% peak-reserve margin and the configured fallback load or previous remaining-day calculation. This changes battery control. Heating and hot water are included in the household profile; future cycles are not scheduled. Unknown heat context or detected unquantified hot-water demand retains the safe fallback. Separate heat-meter mode is not yet supported for the active peak profile.

arbitrage.title: Battery arbitrage estimate
arbitrage.description: Enter your battery cost, lifetime and efficiency assumptions. The display calculates the price spread and residual energy value. Efficiencies, cycle costs and margin also size the peak reserve and decide whether the battery is precharged from the grid before a price peak; invalid values block this precharging. The optional discharge hold retains energy only when complete demand, PV and price forecasts prove that later residual load is materially more valuable. It never starts grid charging and leaves protection, charging and unknown decisions unchanged.

data.hold_enabled: Use residual value as an automatic discharge hold
data.degradation_percent: Assumed battery value loss over the stated cycles
data.margin_ct: Additional margin per kWh battery energy

data_description.enabled: Shows price spread and residual value. Efficiencies, cycle costs and margin also apply to peak pre-charging.
data_description.hold_enabled: Holds energy only with a complete demand, PV and price forecast for a more valuable later residual load. Does not charge from the grid.
data_description.battery_price_eur: Battery share of the purchase price, basis for the cycle costs.
data_description.degradation_percent: Loss of battery value over the assumed full cycles.
data_description.cycles: Number of full cycles the loss of value is spread over.
data_description.usable_capacity_kwh: Usable capacity of the house battery.
data_description.charge_efficiency_percent: Share of grid or PV energy that reaches the battery. 90 % if not set.
data_description.discharge_efficiency_percent: Share of battery energy that reaches the house. 90 % if not set.
data_description.margin_ct: Additional margin per kWh before charging and later discharging pay off.

peak_rank.title: Peak rank control (experimental)
peak_rank.description: Experimental. Otherwise the peak ladder discharges in every hour classified as very expensive or expensive. With this option it holds the battery in an expensive hour when, according to the peak rank shadow comparison, the usable energy only covers even more expensive hours before the next PV refill. Instead of discharging, the mode is then 'Akku nur Laden' (PV charging stays allowed) or, when the strategy currently blocks charging, 'Akku Pause'. It only affects the peak L1 and L2 decisions and only on a clear 'hold' result; with uncertain or missing data the strategy decides as before. Manual modes and all protection functions take precedence. The load and price assumptions can be wrong; energy may then remain unused or expensive grid power may be drawn.

data.enabled: Hold discharge in expensive hours for even more expensive ones

data_description.enabled: Experimental. Holds energy in an expensive hour for even more expensive hours if the battery only lasts for those. Changes the battery control.

observation.title: Observe measurement sources
observation.description: Read-only: active house source stays unchanged. Match the grid connection, additional inverters and excluded loads. HA report timestamps are not proof of a new device measurement. Compare our time-weighted 60-minute value with legacy smoothing; interpolation can differ.

data.instant_house: Unsmoothed house load excluding selected loads

data_description.meter_confirmed: Confirms that the grid meter covers the whole plant scope being compared.
data_description.legacy_floor_w: Lower limit the legacy system applied to its average, so the comparison calculates the same way.
data_description.instant_house: Optional. Instantaneous house consumption after subtracting the excluded loads.
data_description.watch_sources: Up to eight further sources whose report times are recorded.
data_description.additional_ac_sources: AC power of further inverters for the balance.
data_description.excluded_load_sources: Loads such as a wallbox subtracted for the comparison after load deduction.
data_description.gross_house: Optional. Instantaneous total house consumption before load deduction.

ev_preparation.title: PV preparation for the car
ev_preparation.description: Prepare the home battery from PV surplus when vehicle SOC is low, including while away. An optional recurring or absolute departure time can add a vehicle target, usable capacity, available charge power and efficiency. Until that deadline, the vehicle target replaces the simple demand threshold. The report shows required energy, latest charge start and feasibility assuming continuous power; the integration does not control the charger. No additional grid charging. While the car charges, ordinary home charging/discharging pauses and priority protection charging remains. Vehicle SOC expires after 24h; an unknown charging state blocks preparation. Minimum discharge power is limited to 0 W while preparation is enabled.

data.vehicle_charge_efficiency_percent: Charging efficiency to the vehicle battery

data_description.enabled: Pulls existing PV surplus into the house battery earlier when the vehicle state of charge is low. No additional grid charging.
data_description.vehicle_soc: State of charge of the vehicle in percent. Valid for at most 24 hours.
data_description.charging: Reliable signal that the car is charging. Active or unknown pauses normal house battery charging and discharging.
data_description.away: Optional. Switch for longer absence; blocks only the preparation.
data_description.departure: Optional. input_datetime or timestamp sensor. A time of day alone applies daily.
data_description.vehicle_threshold: Below this vehicle state of charge, charging is needed.
data_description.house_target: Up to this state of charge the house battery takes in surplus PV early, at most up to the maximum state of charge.
data_description.vehicle_target_soc: Vehicle target at departure. Replaces the simple need threshold until departure.
data_description.vehicle_capacity_kwh: Usable vehicle battery capacity for departure planning.
data_description.charge_power_kw: Available AC charge power for departure planning.
data_description.vehicle_charge_efficiency_percent: Share of AC energy that reaches the vehicle battery.

active_setup.title: Set up active control
active_setup.description:
This Shadow entry remains permanently read-only.

1. Close this dialog. If you changed settings, save them first via Review and save.
2. Open Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → Opti Akku.
3. Choose Copy Shadow settings for active control and select this Shadow entry.

The new wizard uses the settings as suggestions and checks device identity again. Write access starts disabled. Disable the previous writing controller before the final confirmation. This step itself changes nothing.

evcc_comparison.title: Compare with evcc optimizer
evcc_comparison.description: Read-only. Compares the ladder mode with evcc's battery plan. The sensor "evcc optimizer shadow comparison" is already enabled; it only queries evcc once a source is entered here. The suggestion entity is the ha-evcc battery SoC sensor with the "suggestion" attribute. The evcc address is optional: Opti Akku then reads the evopt result from /api/state every 5 minutes and derives the battery action per slot. Requires the evcc optimizer (Configuration → Experimental).

data_description.suggestion_entity: House battery SoC sensor from ha-evcc with the suggestion attribute.
data_description.url: Optional. Opti Akku then reads the evopt result from /api/state every 5 minutes.
